project.name: MD2PDF
project.description: Web app that loads/edits Markdown and renders it live as paginated A4-style pages with KaTeX math support
project.author: Philip Leichauer

fromProjectPlan: Phase 1 is a previewer only; PDF export deferred to Phase 2
Split-pane UI: Markdown editor (left) + paginated A4 preview (right)
KaTeX for math rendering with HTML/SVG toggle option
Must handle clean page breaks (avoid mid-equation/table splits)
File controls: upload .md files and save .md files
todos: Confirm remoteUrl matches actual GitHub repository or blank if undesired
